title: BBQ Tofu with Corn on the Cob & Creamy Broccoli Slaw

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, remove husks and silks from corn; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, season both sides of the tofu with salt and pepper, then coat with BBQ sauce.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with butter; working in batches if necessary, add tofu and grill until golden and warmed through, 4-5 minutes per side. Return to the baking sheet and coat with additional BBQ sauce.
Once the water is boiling, uncover the pot and reduce heat to medium; use tongs to lower the corn into the water and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry parsley, then shave leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl along with dressing and mayo; whisk to combine.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the broccoli slaw, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide tofu, corn, and slaw between plates; spread corn with butter and sprinkle with salt. Enjoy!
